name: olduname
description: olduname is an older version of the uname system call that retrieves system information into a structure with fixed-length fields of 9 bytes. It provides details such as the operating system name, node name, release, version, and machine type.

parameters.name: buf
parameters.description: Pointer to a struct utsname where the system information is stored

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: buf is not a valid address

bugs: The fields in the structure are limited to 9 bytes, which may truncate information on modern systems; it is a historical limitation.
